headword: {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}

definitions.explanation: medical care focused on comfort and quality of life for patients with terminal illnesses who are nearing death

examples.japanese: {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}のあり{方|かた}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think about the way end-of-life care should be.

examples.japanese: {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}では{患者|かんじゃ}の{痛|いた}みを{和|やわ}らげることが{最|もっと}も{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: In end-of-life care, relieving the patient's pain is the most important thing.

examples.japanese: {高齢化|こうれいか}{社会|しゃかい}の{進展|しんてん}に{伴|ともな}い、{終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}に{対|たい}する{関心|かんしん}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: As the aging society progresses, interest in end-of-life care is growing.

notes:
Medical care provided to patients with incurable, terminal conditions, focusing on comfort rather than cure. Composed of {終末|しゅうまつ} (end, final stage) + {医療|いりょう} (medical care). This is a major topic in Japanese society given the rapidly aging population.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}のあり{方|かた} — the way end-of-life care should be
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}を{受|う}ける — to receive end-of-life care
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}に{携|たずさ}わる — to be involved in end-of-life care
- {終末|しゅうまつ}{医療|いりょう}の{現場|げんば} — the end-of-life care setting

KEY CONCEPTS:
- {緩和|かんわ}ケア — palliative care (focuses on pain relief and comfort)
- ホスピス — hospice (specialized facility for terminal patients)
- {尊厳死|そんげんし} — death with dignity
- {延命|えんめい}{治療|ちりょう} — life-prolonging treatment
- {看取|みと}り — watching over a dying person (attending to someone at the end of life)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ターミナルケア — terminal care (loanword synonym)
- {緩和|かんわ}ケア — palliative care (broader; not limited to the very end of life)
- {在宅|ざいたく}{医療|いりょう} — home medical care (may overlap with end-of-life care at home)
